channel.title: Gambia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Gambia, every source cited.

item.title: Gambia begins repaying D563.8 million bus loan
item.description: The government made its first principal and interest payment in May 2026 for buses procured for the Gambia Transport Service Company.

item.title: Gambia develops clean cooking strategy
item.description: The initiative, supported by the EU and Netherlands, aims to promote safer, cleaner cooking solutions across the nation.

item.title: Gambia reaffirms UN Charter principles
item.description: Vice President Jallow called for stronger partnerships to advance global peace and human rights at UN Day.

item.title: Gambia launches hub for 20 returning migrants
item.description: Kanifing Municipal Council offers services and business support to help returnees rebuild lives.

item.title: Darboe pledges 24-hour power for Gambia's hospitals
item.description: The opposition leader also vowed to improve maternal healthcare and fight corruption if elected president.
